name: Help Scout
description: Help Scout is a customer-support platform for shared inboxes, email conversations, live chat, knowledge bases, customer profiles, workflows, and service reporting. Support teams use it to organize requests, collaborate on replies, automate routine work, and deliver personal customer service.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Help Scout account through OAuth, then let agents read bounded conversation metadata or use the complete account-authorized Mailbox API under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

capabilities.label: Read conversation metadata
capabilities.description: Read the conversation count and bounded privacy-redacted conversation metadata in the connected Help Scout account.

capabilities.label: Full Help Scout Mailbox API
capabilities.description: Use the complete documented Help Scout Mailbox API surface allowed by the authorizing user's role.

allowed.label: Read conversation count
allowed.description: Read the provider-maintained total conversation count.

allowed.label: List conversations
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five privacy-redacted conversation metadata summaries.

allowed.label: Read conversation metadata
allowed.description: Read one privacy-redacted conversation metadata summary by numeric ID.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Help Scout API
approvalRequired.description: Use any documented Help Scout Mailbox API operation authorized by the connected user; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded privacy-redacted conversation reads run directly; every other Help Scout API operation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected Help Scout operation runs without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, exact user binding, secret isolation, request bounds, audits, provider roles, and provider limits still apply.

providerSetup.blocker: A Relay-owned Help Scout OAuth app, staging credentials, and an authorized test account are required for live acceptance outside this code task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, create the Help Scout app with Relay's exact callback, add staging credentials, then verify authorization, exact-user binding, token rotation, bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous mutation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Help Scout documents OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code for integrations used by other customers, the exact authorization and token endpoints, registered callback, two-day access-token expiry, and rotating access/refresh token pairs.
The official Mailbox API reference fixes the API origin at api.helpscout.net/v2 and documents conversations, mailboxes, users, customers, workflows, webhooks, and other support operations.
The conversation-list endpoint returns bounded pages and provider-maintained totalElements metadata; Relay fixes the first page and redacts private content from its dedicated read tools.
The exact conversation endpoint documents conversation metadata and linked private content; Relay's dedicated read tool returns only an allowlisted metadata projection.
